rules_text.raw: You can choose two effects instead of one effect, or may choose to enhance one effect. If you enhance the attack effect, all of the creature’s natural attacks are affected. If you enhance the defense effect, in addition to fleshcurdle ’s normal effect on natural armor bonus, any critical threats against the creature gain a +4 bonus on the confirmation roll. If you enhance the movement effect, all of the creature’s movement speeds are halved.

augmentations.name: Augmented (6th)
augmentations.raw: If you expend two uses of mythic power, you can choose two enhanced effects to inflict upon the target.
